statement: Pinned SDL Wii HIDAPI initializes software stick calibration ranges/deadzones by extension category, learns neutral center from its first samples, and adjusts observed axis extrema while mapping motion to gamepad axes. This is application-side adaptive joystick calibration, not a read of Nunchuk/Classic calibration registers or a device-side checksum policy.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_wii.c 594-625 and 882-915; source consumer behavior. Does not establish that other apps ignore factory calibration.
